Choose a starting point

IVF covers a broader treatment process; ICSI changes the laboratory fertilisation step. Egg freezing preserves eggs for possible future use, while FET uses existing frozen embryos.

Sperm freezing and donor options

Sperm freezing, donated eggs or sperm, and third-party family-building involve separate screening, resource availability, consent and document requirements. Discuss your circumstances with the receiving institution.

Single people and LGBTQ+ families

Explain your family-building goals first. Medical eligibility, donor resources, third-party involvement, parentage documents and cross-border requirements need individual confirmation.

ICSI — intracytoplasmic sperm injection

An embryologist injects one sperm into an egg. ICSI changes the fertilisation step within IVF; it is not a complete treatment cycle or a universal way to improve live-birth rates.

Egg freezing and fertility preservation

Eggs are retrieved and frozen for possible future use. This preserves an option and does not guarantee a future pregnancy or birth.

Source and further reading

Understand success rates before comparing plans

A percentage needs context. Match the patient group and treatment stage before comparing results.

Understand success rates before comparing plans
MeasureCycles includedWhat to ask
Per intended retrievalCycles started with medication or monitoring for planned retrieval.Are cancelled cycles and cycles without retrieval included?
Per actual retrievalCycles that reached egg retrieval.Are retrievals without a transferable embryo included?
Per transferCycles that reached embryo transfer.One transfer, or cumulative results from transfers after one retrieval?

Per intended retrieval

Cycles included
Cycles started with medication or monitoring for planned retrieval.
What to ask
Are cancelled cycles and cycles without retrieval included?

Per actual retrieval

Cycles included
Cycles that reached egg retrieval.
What to ask
Are retrievals without a transferable embryo included?

Per transfer

Cycles included
Cycles that reached embryo transfer.
What to ask
One transfer, or cumulative results from transfers after one retrieval?
Patient group
Separate own eggs from donor eggs. For own eggs, check age at retrieval.
Outcome
Ask whether the result is pregnancy, live birth or singleton live birth.
Year and sample
Check treatment year, cycle count and follow-up window for cumulative results.

Clinic-level results describe past groups. A doctor assesses your individual prospects using your history and tests.
